beats.prose:
The bell had been underwater for twenty years. Tonight, someone heard it ring.

Mara waited on the quay with two cups of tea. When Iona arrived, she did not take hers. “Tell me the chart is still in your room.”

Behind them, the harbour lights came on one by one.
